name: What areas in Miami-Dade County have active new construction developments?

mainEntity.name: What areas in Miami-Dade County have active new construction developments?

acceptedAnswer.text: Miami-Dade County has active new construction developments in several areas, including Aventura, Brickell, Coral Gables, Downtown Miami, Edgewater, and Sunny Isles Beach. Areas like Pinecrest also see custom home builds. The specific availability of new construction can vary by property type, from high-rise condos to single-family homes. When considering a location, research the developer's reputation, future development plans for the area, and local amenities. Kelby Contreras can provide current insights into specific projects and their locations.
